claims.claim: Independent expected-state parity, all nine activation gates, controlled-clock eligibility, pointer preservation, and public-API recovery pass in bounded local and CI execution.
A frozen 3-by-3 local workload matrix retained 486 correctness-bound raw trials and deterministic summaries.
Versioned bounded telemetry events and operator diagnosis rules are implementation-present without a deployed telemetry backend.
AWS and DynamoDB runtime performance, cloud cost, service availability, production scale, and SLO compliance are not established.

explicit_non_claims: No AWS, DynamoDB, Glue, Terraform, deployment, or release operation was executed.
Local SQLite timing is not evidence of DynamoDB latency or concurrency behavior.
Small local Spark timing is not a production throughput or scalability result.
No cost, availability, durability, alert delivery, or production SLO claim is made.
